fichas.title: Spa: Sauna/Wellness
fichas.summary: Overview of spa and wellness facilities, sauna functions, room arrangements and approximate space requirements by sauna size. The page includes a functional scheme, example wash and cooling room plans, plunge-pool sections, and tables of capacities and room areas.
